intro: Hello! I am Mimi, your course tutor. I can explain this lesson, answer your questions, tell you about jobs and connect you to a tutor. Shall we continue in English? For Amharic, say “Amharic”.
introSpoken: Hello, I am Mimi, your course assistant. I can explain this lesson, answer your questions, and connect you with a tutor. Shall we continue in English?
greetingWelcome: Hello! I am Mimi, your course tutor.

menu.intro: What would you like to do?
menu.repeat: To hear the choices again, say 0 or press 0.

chat.say: To see the chat and the sources

read.say: To hear this lesson section by section

explain.say: To explain the part you are reading

title: Mimi, your course tutor
subtitle: Your bilingual course tutor. Answers come from your course pages.
telegramLabel: Continue on Telegram (opens Telegram in a new tab)
screenShareAndroid: Screen sharing is not supported in Chrome on Android. Your current lesson page is shared with the tutor.
local: Answered by the local model on this computer.
error: I could not reach the tutor service. Check that it is running, then try again.
confirm: Great! I will help you in English. What would you like to know? You can ask me about this lesson, or say “explain this lesson”.
chooseRetry: Sorry, I did not catch that. Say or press 1 for Amharic, 2 for English, or 3 for Afaan Oromo.
askNow: Go ahead, ask your question. I am listening.
jobsQuestion: What jobs are open for me, and how do I apply?
escalated: I opened a chat with a person [1]. A tutor will answer you there. If nobody is online right now, the answer may come in the morning, and the chat stays open for you.
escalateFailed: I could not reach the help service just now. Please try again in a moment.
menuTitle: What can I do for you?
partialSpoken: The rest of my answer is written above.
langInferred: I will reply in English. You can change this at any time.
sChoose: Listening: say “English”, or just ask your question
sChooseNoMic: Choose a language above, or type your question
sText: Voice is off: type your message
sTextNoMic: The microphone is not available: type your reply
sTyping: Listening is paused while you type
sPress: Your turn: press “Press to talk”, or press a menu number
voiceTurnedOff: Voice is off. Keep typing: your conversation and language are kept.
quiet: It has been quiet for a while, so I paused listening. Press Resume listening when you are ready.
micDenied: The microphone is blocked, so I can't hear you. Allow it in your browser settings, or type your reply.
micNone: No microphone was found. Please type your reply.
micLang: This browser cannot recognise speech in this language. Please type your reply.
micNetwork: Speech recognition is not reachable right now. Please type your reply.
noVoice: No {voice} voice is available on this device right now, so please read my reply on screen.
speechBlocked: Tap anywhere or press any key, and Mimi will start talking.
speechUnavailable: Speech output is not available in this browser. You can still read and type here.
welcome: Hi, I'm Mimi, your course tutor. Talk to me or type: I can explain this lesson, answer questions about your course, and quiz you. I answer from your course pages and show you the sources.
suggestions: What is the late policy for WR 100?
Is the future of VA work promising?
Give me a practice question on this lesson.
offerPerson: Would you like to talk to a person instead? Press “Talk to a person”, or say {n}.
consentText: To understand your voice, speak and write answers, Mimi sends your questions and voice to online services (Google and Microsoft). Your name is not sent. If you say no, Mimi answers from the course text on this website only, by text.
consentOff: Online services are off: nothing you write leaves this website. Answers come from the course text. You can turn on “Online AI and voice” in the chat settings.
offlineNoMic: Listening needs the online services, which are off. Type your question, or turn on “Online AI and voice” in the chat settings.
movedAside: Mimi moved aside so you can see the page. Press “Open Mimi” to bring her back.
savedOffline: Saved on this phone. It will send when you are online.
sendingSaved: You are online again: sending your saved question.
downloaded: The conversation was saved as a file on this device.
explainAsk: Explain this part of the lesson in simple words: "{text}"
explainNothing: Select a part of the lesson first, or scroll to the part you want explained, then ask again.
readAsk: Explain this section of the lesson in simple words, in three or four short sentences: "{title}. {text}"
readLast: That was the last section of this lesson.
readNone: I could not find lesson sections on this page.
readStopped: I stopped reading. You can ask me anything about the lesson.
escalateSuggest: This is not in the course either. A tutor can help: press “Talk to a person”, or say {n}.
escalatedPress: I opened a chat with a person. To open it, press Enter, or tap “Open the help chat”. A tutor will answer you there. If nobody is online right now, the answer may come in the morning, and the chat stays open for you.
chooseOthers: For Amharic, press 1. For English, press 2. For Afaan Oromo, press 3.
accommodationChip: Ask for support in a job interview
